env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_guard_attacks.lgo a/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_hoist_scope.lgo b/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_guard_goto.lgo c/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_guard_attacks.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_guard_attacks.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd b
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_hoist_scope.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_hoist_scope.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd c
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_guard_goto.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chains_guard_goto.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/chainguardsa

go 1.27
-- b/go.mod --
module example.com/chainguardsb

go 1.27
-- c/go.mod --
module example.com/chainguardsc

go 1.27
